import MumfordLib.CircleProductExactSplitting
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleProductConnecting
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyCircleProductRetraction

/-!
# Integral cohomology of a product with the circle

The antipodal Mayer--Vietoris sequence gives an unconditional additive
decomposition of positive-degree singular cohomology of `X × Circle`.
The first summand is pulled back from `X`, and the second summand is the
connecting class of the first overlap component.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance 2000] Prod.instModule

open CategoryTheory Limits HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- Both chart coordinates of a global class equal its first-factor retraction. -/
theorem circleProductMayerVietoris_restriction_apply (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) (a : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) n) :
    circleProductChartPairCohomologyEquiv X v n
      (singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
        (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v)) n a) =
      (circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v n a,
        circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v n a) := by
  let A := IntegralSingularCohomology X n
  let p := circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v n
  have h : singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
      (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v)) n ≫
      (biprod.mapIso (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X v n)
        (circleProductChartCohomologyIso X (-v) n)).inv ≫
      (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd A A).hom = ModuleCat.ofHom (p.prod p) := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, circleProductMayerVietoris_restriction]
    apply (cancel_mono (ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd A A).inv).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    apply biprod.hom_ext
    · simp only [Category.assoc, biprod.lift_fst]
      rw [ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd_inv_comp_fst]
      rfl
    · simp only [Category.assoc, biprod.lift_snd]
      rw [ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd_inv_comp_snd]
      rfl
  exact congrArg (fun f => f a) h

/-- Vanishing of restriction to both charts is equivalent to vanishing
of the first-factor retraction. -/
theorem circleProductMayerVietoris_restriction_eq_zero_iff (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) (a : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) n) :
    singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
      (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v)) n a = 0 ↔
      circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v n a = 0 := by
  rw [← (circleProductChartPairCohomologyEquiv X v n).map_eq_zero_iff,
    circleProductMayerVietoris_restriction_apply]
  simp only [Prod.mk_eq_zero, and_self]

/-- Exactness at the cohomology of the product, expressed in the first-factor
and overlap coordinates. -/
theorem circleProductCohomologyConnecting_exact_retraction (X : TopCat) (v : Circle)
    (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact (circleProductCohomologyConnecting X v n)
      (circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v (n + 1)) := by
  have hex := (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact _).mp
    (singularCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_union (TopCat.of (X × Circle))
      (circleProductChart X v) (circleProductChart X (-v))
      (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).1 (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.1
      (circleProductChart_open_cover X v).2.2 n)
  intro a
  rw [← circleProductMayerVietoris_restriction_eq_zero_iff, hex]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n b, ?_⟩
    simp only [circleProductCohomologyConnecting, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(circleProductOverlapCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm b, rfl⟩

/-- The additive circle-product decomposition of integral singular cohomology.
The choice of antipodal chart fixes the sign of the second summand. -/
def circleProductCohomologyEquiv (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) (n + 1) ≃ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSingularCohomology X (n + 1) × IntegralSingularCohomology X n :=
  circleProductExactSplitting (circleProductCohomologyPullback X (n + 1))
    (circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v (n + 1))
    (circleProductCohomologyConnecting X v n)
    (LinearMap.ext (circleProductCohomologyRetraction_left_inverse X v (n + 1)))
    (circleProductCohomologyConnecting_eq_zero_iff X v n)
    (circleProductCohomologyConnecting_exact_retraction X v n)

/-- The inverse combines pullback and the connecting class of the first
overlap component. -/
@[simp]
theorem circleProductCohomologyEquiv_symm_apply (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ)
    (a : IntegralSingularCohomology X (n + 1)) (b : IntegralSingularCohomology X n) :
    (circleProductCohomologyEquiv X v n).symm (a, b) =
      circleProductCohomologyPullback X (n + 1) a +
        circleProductCohomologyConnecting X v n (b, 0) :=
  circleProductExactSplitting_symm_apply _ _ _ _ _ _ a b

@[simp]
theorem circleProductCohomologyEquiv_apply_fst (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ)
    (a : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Circle)) (n + 1)) :
    (circleProductCohomologyEquiv X v n a).1 =
      circleProductCohomologyRetraction X v (n + 1) a :=
  circleProductExactSplitting_apply_fst _ _ _ _ _ _ a

@[simp]
theorem circleProductCohomologyEquiv_apply_pullback (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ)
    (a : IntegralSingularCohomology X (n + 1)) :
    circleProductCohomologyEquiv X v n
      (circleProductCohomologyPullback X (n + 1) a) = (a, 0) :=
  circleProductExactSplitting_apply_section _ _ _ _ _ _ a

@[simp]
theorem circleProductCohomologyEquiv_apply_connecting (X : TopCat) (v : Circle) (n : ℕ)
    (b c : IntegralSingularCohomology X n) :
    circleProductCohomologyEquiv X v n
      (circleProductCohomologyConnecting X v n (b, c)) = (0, b - c) :=
  circleProductExactSplitting_apply_connecting _ _ _ _ _ _ b c

end Mumford.Analytic
